summary.text: Harold Love is the Democratic state representative for Tennessee House District 58, part of Davidson County in Nashville, and a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the pastor of Lee Chapel AME Church and has served in the House since the 108th General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Love graduated from Whites Creek Comprehensive High School in 1990 and from Tennessee State University in 1994 with a degree in economics and finance.
He earned a master's degree in theological studies from Vanderbilt University in 1998 and a Ph.D. in public policy and administration from Tennessee State University in 2017.
The legislature's biography lists him as pastor of Lee Chapel AME Church.
Love has been a member of the House since the 108th General Assembly, served as House Democratic Caucus Secretary in the 108th, and was Minority Floor Leader from January through August 2019.
He is the Assistant Democratic Caucus Leader and served as president of the National Black Caucus of State Legislators.
